claims.evidence: One source per genotype per independent biological replicate experiment. MaxQuant summary.txt assigns every raw file to one of three experiments SCW_II_29_FirstForw, SCW_II_68_SecForw, SCW_II_53_Reverse; the paper: "We performed three independent biological replicate experiments. In two of them, GCLM(+/+) (wild-type) astrocytes were cultured in light SILAC media ... while GCLM(-/-) astrocytes were cultured in heavy ... in the third experiment, a label swap was used."
PRIDE organisms NEWT:10090; paper: primary cultures from C57BL/6J mice; NCBITaxon:10090 Mus musculus (OLS).

Paper/PRIDE protocol: "Primary astrocyte cultures were prepared from the cortex of 1 to 2-day-old mice". UBERON:0000956 cerebral cortex (OLS). PRIDE organismParts lists the cell type astrocyte (CL:0000127), which goes to cell type.
Primary astrocyte cultures, ">98% pure as determined by glial fibrillary acidic protein ... immunoreactivity". CL:0000127 astrocyte (OLS).

Three independent biological replicate experiments (paper), each a separate pair of WT and GCLM(-/-) primary astrocyte cultures; MaxQuant experiments SCW_II_29_FirstForw, SCW_II_68_SecForw, SCW_II_53_Reverse. Numbered 1..3 within each factor-value group (wild type, Gclm knockout), one number per independent culture (campaign rule 3). The numbering order follows the MaxQuant experiment names (FirstForw, SecForw, Reverse); it is not claimed to equal the paper Fig. 1B "Exp. 1-3" numbering, which refers to the separate gel-LC protein expression experiment.
No disease is modelled in the cultures: the compared variable is the Gclm genotype (glutathione deficiency). ALS is the motivating context only (the ALS mouse model is from a previous study).
Primary astrocyte cultures (not a cell line).

All 85 deposited runs are anti-acetyl-lysine immunoprecipitates of SCX fractions ("Acetylated peptides were immunoprecipitated from each fraction ... antiacetylated lysine antibody conjugated to agarose beads (ImmuneChem)"). EFO:0009090 descendants contain no acetyl-peptide-specific term (only enrichment of phosphorylated protein / cell isolation terms), so the generic EFO:0009106 sample enrichment is used.
Donor age: cultures "prepared from the cortex of 1 to 2-day-old mice". EFO:0001372 neonate (OLS). The cells were then cultured ~21 days in vitro (paper Results).
Paper Animals: "Male and female C57BL/6J-GCLM(+/-) mice were crossed to generate wild-type and GCLM(-/-) littermates." Free text column; validator warns that NCBITaxon has no such term.

GCLM(+/+) vs GCLM(-/-) littermate-derived astrocytes. Channel assignment from the paper/PRIDE protocol (forward: WT light, KO heavy; label swap in the third experiment = MaxQuant SCW_II_53_Reverse) and checked against deposited ratios (see comment[label] claim). Custom characteristics column (vertebrates template does not list genotype; spec Extending Templates).
The compared variable: GCLM(-/-)/GCLM(+/+) ratios. Same values and rows as characteristics[genotype].

claims.evidence: Paper: "For acetyl peptide analysis, 12 LC-MS/MS analyses were performed for each biological replicate. The first biological replicate was analyzed three times, and the remaining biological replicates were analyzed twice each (84 LC-MS/MS analyses)." Deposit: 36 runs for SCW_II_29, 24 for SCW_II_68, 25 for SCW_II_53 (24 + one extra injection of fraction 1 named _repeat). Analysis series numbered chronologically by acquisition date in the file names; raw headers show 2013 series used method 120mingrad_FTprofile_onlyCID_MIPs_TOP20 and the 2014 2ndZT series 180mingrad_FT_onlyCID_TOP10_022714_SILAC (paper: "gradient of 5-50% in 120 or 180 min"). The _repeat injection is given technical replicate 3 (fraction 1 only) to keep the row coordinate unique.

Peptides separated into 12 SCX fractions, each immunoprecipitated and run once per series. Fraction = trailing ordinal of the file name (050713_SCW_II_29_4_1 -> 1 ... _50_12 -> 12, where the middle number is the collected SCX tube; Second_ZT likewise; Enriched_N, N_2ndZT, N_Vargas_Enriched -> N). The _repeat file is fraction 1.
SCX on a Resource S column, 12 fractions.
Raw headers: "Orbitrap Elite MS" / "Orbitrap Elite ETD" in all 8 sampled files; paper: Orbitrap Elite; PRIDE MS:1001910 (OLS label Orbitrap Elite).
TOP20 (2013) / TOP10 (2014 method name) data-dependent acquisition; raw scan filter "ITMS + c ... Dep MS/MS Most intense ion from (1)".
Paper: "Fragmentation in the ion trap was performed by collision-induced dissociation"; raw scan filter ITMS + c (CID).
MS/MS acquired in the linear ion trap (ITMS scan filter).
Paper: survey scan m/z 400-1700; raw scan filter FTMS + p norm o(400.0-1700.0) in all sampled files.

limitations: Partial deposit (PRIDE submissionType PARTIAL): only the 85 lysine-acetylation (anti-acetyl-lysine IP) LC-MS/MS runs and their single MaxQuant search are deposited. The 36 gel-LC-MS/MS protein-expression runs described in the paper are not in PXD001834, so they are not annotated; nothing was left out of the deposit.

Technical replicate numbering is chronological by acquisition series; the paper does not say which series is "first" for each biological replicate, nor what the 2014 "2ndZT" label (likely a second ZipTip desalting/re-analysis) means exactly. The extra 022714_SCW_II_53_1_2ndZT_repeat injection is technical replicate 3 (fraction 1 only).

Sex of the neonatal donor pups is not reported (male and female breeders); characteristics[sex] = not available. Whether each culture pooled several pups is not stated, so no pooled-sample column is asserted.
Biological replicate numbers 1-3 follow the MaxQuant experiment names (FirstForw, SecForw, Reverse); the mapping to the paper figure "Exp. 1-3" is not asserted.
Precursor tolerance 4.5 ppm is from the paper text (MaxQuant main search after recalibration); parameters.txt of MaxQuant 1.5.0.30 does not record it and no mqpar.xml is deposited.
characteristics[enrichment process] uses the generic EFO:0009106 sample enrichment because EFO has no acetyl-lysine peptide enrichment term under EFO:0009090.
Supplementary tables of the paper (MCP) were not retrieved; the channel map relies on the paper text/PRIDE protocol plus the deposited MaxQuant ratios.
